title: GTA 6 Fronts Next Game Informer Cover with New Info and Screenshots
description: GTA 6 is set to feature on the next Game Informer cover with a 14-page story, exclusive Rockstar Games interviews, and a dozen new screenshots on September 29, 2026.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Headines New Game Informer Issue with 14-Page Cover Story

Excitement for Rockstar Games' upcoming open-world epic continues to mount as media outlets prepare for major new reveals. According to a recent report by Push Square, GTA 6 is set to take center stage on the cover of the next Game Informer issue, bringing a fresh wave of official information and never-before-seen screenshots for fans to dissect.

The highly anticipated issue is scheduled for release on Tuesday, 29th September 2026. For a community that has been eagerly analyzing every frame of previous official media, this upcoming feature promises a substantial look at what is shaping up to be one of the biggest entertainment launches in history.

## Jason and Lucia Take the Cover in Style

The magazine's front cover prominently features the game's two protagonists, Jason and Lucia. The artwork offers yet another stylized glimpse of the criminal duo, depicting them inside a car equipped with firearms. This striking imagery reinforces the Bonnie-and-Clyde-style dynamic that has been a major talking point since the game's initial reveal.

Beyond the eye-catching cover, Game Informer has teased a massive 14-page cover story dedicated entirely to the next Rockstar open-worlder. The feature is set to include exclusive interviews with Rockstar Games, providing rare behind-the-scenes insights directly from the developers. Most excitingly for visual enthusiasts, the issue will showcase a dozen new screenshots, offering a closer look at the game's fidelity, environments, and character models.

## What to Expect Next Week

As the 29th of September approaches, gaming enthusiasts and analysts alike will be keeping a close eye on the details emerging from Game Informer's comprehensive feature. While major gameplay deep-dives are often tightly controlled by Rockstar, the promise of developer interviews and a dozen fresh screenshots guarantees plenty of fresh discussion points regarding the fictional state of Leonida and the gameplay systems powering Jason and Lucia's journey.

## Editor's Take

Game Informer's upcoming 14-page cover story is a welcome development in the rollout of GTA 6 news. With exclusive interviews and a dozen new screenshots arriving on September 29, 2026, fans finally have a confirmed date to look forward to for fresh, official insights straight from the developers.
